examples.en: You can't see the forest for the trees.

examples.text: Группа начала кампанию по сохранению леса.
examples.en: A group started a campaign to preserve rain forests.

examples.text: Я построил дом в двух шагах от леса.
examples.en: I built a house within a stone's throw of the forest.
Forests are the lungs of the earth.
